items.title: 3.1 Antiderivatives and The Indefinite Integral (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum bachon! Aaj hum calculus ke doosre bare hisse, yani integration, ka safar shuru kar rahe hain. Unit 2 mein aap ne differentiation seekha tha: function diya hota tha aur hum us ka derivative (rate of change, yani tabdeeli ki raftaar) nikaalte the. Ab hum ulta kaam karenge: derivative diya hoga aur humein woh asal function dhoondna hoga jis se yeh derivative aaya. Bilkul aise jaise kisi ne aap ko bataya ke gaari har ghante 60 km chali, aur aap se poocha jaye ke kul kitna faasla tay hua.
INTRODUCTION

Kitab ka introduction yeh kehta hai: pichle units mein humne differentiation parha aur us se rates of change, curves ke slopes, maxima aur minima, aur roz marra ke masail hal kiye. Is unit mein hum integration parhenge, jo differentiation ka ulta (reverse) process hai. Yeh calculus ki woh shaakh hai jis se accumulation (jama hone wali miqdaar), area, volume aur kul tabdeeli (total change) nikaali jaati hai. Hum antiderivatives, indefinite aur definite integrals, un ki notation, properties aur buniyadi rules (power rule samait), aur Fundamental Theorem of Calculus seekhenge. Definite integral ka curve ke neeche wale net area se rishta dekhenge, curves aur lines ke beech ka area aur solids of revolution ka volume nikaalenge. Integration ke ahem tareeqe bhi seekhenge: substitution, integration by parts, trigonometric substitution, partial fractions, aur exponential aur logarithmic functions wale integrals. Integration ka istemal maths, physics, engineering, economics, biology aur technology mein hota hai, maslan containers ka volume, population growth, consumer aur producer surplus, faasla aur velocity, dawai ki dose (drug dosage), moment of inertia aur sensor networks ki measurements.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Ek baat dil mein bitha lijiye: differentiation sawal karta hai 'function diya hai, is ka rate of change kya hai?' Integration ulta sawal karta hai 'rate of change diya hai, asal function kaunsa tha?'
Is ka faida yeh hai ke Unit 2 ka har derivative formula ulta parhein to integration ka formula ban jata hai. Maslan \(\frac{d}{dx}(x^{2}) = 2x\) ko ulta parhiye: 'woh function jis ka derivative \(2x\) hai, \(x^{2}\) hai.'
Is liye derivatives ke formulas ko taaza rakhiye; poora unit inhi par khara hai. Jis student ko derivatives zabani yaad hain, us ke liye integration aadha aasan ho jata hai.
Ab kitab ki pehli definition dekhte hain. Ghor se parhiye, kyun ke aage sab kuch isi par banega.

Definition: Ek function \(F\) ko kisi diye hue function \(f\) ka antiderivative kehte hain ek interval \(I\) par, agar \(I\) ke har \(x\) ke liye \(F'(x) = f(x)\) ho. Doosre lafzon mein, kisi function \(F\) ko us ke derivative \(f\) se wapas haasil karne ke process ko antidifferentiation kehte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is definition ko ek test ki tarah parhiye. Agar aap ko check karna hai ke \(F\) waqai \(f\) ka antiderivative hai ya nahin, to \(F\) ko differentiate kijiye. Agar jawab \(f\) aaye to haan, warna nahin. Bas itni si baat hai.
'Anti' ka matlab hai 'ulta'. Antidifferentiation, differentiation ko undo karta hai, bilkul jaise subtraction addition ko undo karti hai: \(5 + 3 = 8\) ho to \(8 - 3 = 5\).
Interval \(I\) ka zikr kyun? Kyun ke kuch functions har jagah defined nahin hote. Maslan \(\frac{1}{x}\) ki value \(x = 0\) par hai hi nahin, is liye hum aise interval par kaam karte hain jis mein 0 shamil na ho.

Kitab ki misaal: maan lijiye \(f(x) = 2x\). Agar \(F(x) = x^{2}\) ho to \(F'(x) = 2x = f(x)\). Is ke ilawa function \(G(x) = x^{2} + 10\) bhi \(G'(x) = 2x = f(x)\) deta hai. Is liye agar \(F(x)\) kisi interval par \(f(x)\) ka koi bhi antiderivative ho, to \(c\) ki har value ke liye \(F(x) + c\) bhi usi interval par \(f(x)\) ka antiderivative hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Ab sawal yeh hai ke constant jorne se farq kyun nahin parta? Wajah seedhi hai: constant ka derivative zero hota hai.
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\big(F(x) + c\big) = F'(x) + 0\]
\[= f(x)\]
Is liye \(x^{2}\), \(x^{2} + 10\), \(x^{2} - 3\), \(x^{2} + \sqrt{2}\) sab ka derivative \(2x\) hai. Matlab ek function ka sirf ek antiderivative nahin, balke poora khandan (family) hota hai.
Graph ki zabaan mein: \(y = x^{2} + c\) wale curves ek hi parabola hain jo sirf upar ya neeche khisak gaye hain. Kisi bhi \(x\) par sab ka slope \(2x\) hi hai, is liye sab ka derivative ek jaisa hai. Jaise ek hi seedhi (stairs) ko upar ya neeche rakh dein, us ki dhalaan wahi rehti hai.
Ek aur pakki baat (Mean Value Theorem se saabit hoti hai): kisi interval par ek hi function ke do antiderivatives mein sirf constant ka farq hota hai. Is liye \(F(x) + c\) likhne se koi antiderivative chhoot-ta nahin.

Is \(c\) ko roz marra ki misaal se samajhiye. Maan lijiye aap ko sirf itna bataya gaya hai ke ek gaari har lamhe kitni tez chal rahi hai (yani us ki position ka derivative). Is se aap yeh to nikaal sakte hain ke gaari ne kitna faasla tay kiya, magar yeh nahin bata sakte ke gaari safar shuru karte waqt kahan khari thi: Lahore mein, Multan mein, ya kahin aur. Woh starting point hi \(c\) hai. Jab tak koi extra maloomat (jaise 'shuru mein gaari zero kilometer ke nishaan par thi') na di jaye, \(c\) ki value tay nahin hoti. Aage exercises mein aise sawal bhi aayenge jahan aisi shart de kar \(c\) ki pakki value nikaali jaati hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Sawal: kya \(x^{2} - 100\) bhi \(2x\) ka antiderivative hai? Aur \(x^{2} + x\)?
Jawab: pehla haan, kyun ke \(\frac{d}{dx}(x^{2} - 100) = 2x\). Doosra nahin, kyun ke \(\frac{d}{dx}(x^{2} + x) = 2x + 1\), jo \(2x\) nahin hai. Yaad rahe: sirf constant jor sakte hain, \(x\) wala term nahin.
Ab is poore khandan ko ek naam aur ek nishaan diya jata hai. Kitab ki doosri definition:

Definition: Maan lijiye \(F\) interval \(I\) par \(f\) ka ek antiderivative hai. \(f\) ke tamam antiderivatives ke set (ya family) ko \(x\) ke lihaaz se \(f(x)\) ka indefinite integral kehte hain. Ise \(\int f(x)\,dx\) se zahir karte hain aur yun define karte hain: \(\int f(x)\,dx = F(x) + c\), jahan \(F'(x) = f(x)\) aur \(c\) koi bhi constant (arbitrary constant) hai.
Notation \(\int f(x)\,dx = F(x) + c\) ke har hisse ka naam yaad kar lijiye:

items: (i) Nishaan \(\int\) ko integral sign kehte hain.
(ii) \(\int f(x)\,dx\) ko \(f(x)\) ka indefinite integral kehte hain.
(iii) Integral sign ke andar wala function \(f(x)\) integrand kehlata hai.
(iv) Nishaan \(dx\) ko \(x\) ka differential kehte hain. Yeh variable of integration batata hai, yani woh variable jis ke lihaaz se integration ki ja rahi hai.
(vi) \(c\) ko constant of integration kehte hain.

blocks.text: Ab in naamon ko ek misaal par laga kar dekhte hain, taa ke yeh sirf ratta na rahein. \(\int 6x^{5}\,dx = x^{6} + c\) mein: \(\int\) integral sign hai; \(6x^{5}\) integrand hai (jis cheez ka integral lena hai); \(dx\) batata hai ke variable \(x\) hai; \(x^{6}\) ek antiderivative hai, kyun ke \(\frac{d}{dx}(x^{6}) = 6x^{5}\); aur \(c\) constant of integration hai. Exam mein aksar poocha jata hai ke 'integrand kya hai' ya 'constant of integration kya hai', is liye har hisse ka naam saaf yaad rakhiye.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Sawal: \(\int 4t^{3}\,dt\) mein variable of integration kaunsa hai, aur jawab kya hoga?
Jawab: \(dt\) bata raha hai ke variable \(t\) hai. \(\frac{d}{dt}(t^{4}) = 4t^{3}\), is liye \(\int 4t^{3}\,dt = t^{4} + c\). Jawab \(t\) mein hi likhna hai, \(x\) mein nahin.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(\int 2x\,dx = x^{2} + c\) ko zabaan se kaise parhein: '\(2x\) ka integral \(x\) ke lihaaz se \(x^{2}\) plus \(c\) hai.'
\(\int\) asal mein ek lamba kheencha hua S hai ('sum' yani jor ka S). Yeh naam kyun pada, woh definite integral wale hisse mein samajh aayega.
\(\int\) aur \(dx\) hamesha jori mein aate hain, jaise bracket kholna aur band karna: \(\int\) kholta hai, \(dx\) band karta hai, aur integrand beech mein baithta hai. \(dx\) chhorna aisa hai jaise bracket khol kar band karna bhool jayein.
Ise 'indefinite' (ghair-muayyan, yani pakka tay nahin) kyun kehte hain? Kyun ke jawab ek pakka function nahin; \(c\) koi bhi number ho sakta hai.
\(d\) ke baad wala harf variable batata hai. \(\int 3t^{2}\,dt = t^{3} + c\) mein variable \(t\) hai, is liye jawab bhi \(t\) mein likha jata hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin. Har ek ke tamam antiderivatives nikaaliye aur differentiate kar ke check kijiye.
(a) \(f(x) = 3x^{2}\). Sochiye: kis function ka derivative \(3x^{2}\) hai? Humein yaad hai \(\frac{d}{dx}(x^{3}) = 3x^{2}\). Is liye
\[\int 3x^{2}\,dx = x^{3} + c\]
Tasdeeq: \(\frac{d}{dx}(x^{3} + c) = 3x^{2}\). Sahi!
(b) \(f(x) = \cos x\). Kis ka derivative \(\cos x\) hai? \(\sin x\) ka. Is liye
\[\int \cos x\,dx = \sin x + c\]
(c) \(f(x) = 3x^{2} + 2x\). \(x^{3}\) se \(3x^{2}\) aata hai aur \(x^{2}\) se \(2x\), to
\[\int (3x^{2} + 2x)\,dx = x^{3} + x^{2} + c\]
Dekhiye: hum ne har baar derivative ka formula ulta parha. Agle sabaq (3.1.1) mein yahi kaam rules ki shakal mein seekhenge taa ke andaza na lagana pare.

To aaj ke sabaq ka khulasa yeh hai: integration ka matlab hai derivative se asal function tak wapas jana, aur jawab hamesha ek poora khandan hota hai, is liye \(+\,c\) lagta hai. Agle sabaq 3.1.1 mein hum woh buniyadi rules seekhenge (constant, sum, power, logarithm aur linear substitution wale) jin se yeh kaam andaze ki bajaye ek pakke tareeqe se hota hai, aur 3.1.2 mein derivatives ki poori table ko ulta kar ke integration ke formulas banayenge.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(F\), \(f\) ka antiderivative hai jab \(F'(x) = f(x)\) ho.
2. Ek antiderivative \(F\) mil jaye to har \(F(x) + c\) bhi antiderivative hai; in sab ka set indefinite integral hai: \(\int f(x)\,dx = F(x) + c\).
3. \(\int\) integral sign hai, \(f(x)\) integrand, \(dx\) variable of integration batata hai, aur \(c\) constant of integration hai.
4. Integration, differentiation ka ulta hai: har derivative formula ulta parhein to integration formula ban jata hai.
5. Har integral ka jawab differentiate kar ke check kijiye: integrand wapas aana chahiye.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Indefinite integral mein \(+\,c\) bhool jana. Is se aap poore khandan mein se sirf ek member likhte hain, aur exam mein number kat-te hain.
2. \(dx\) chhor dena, ya jawab ghalat variable mein likhna: \(\int 3t^{2}\,dt\) ka jawab \(t^{3} + c\) hai, \(x^{3} + c\) nahin.
3. Integrate karne ki bajaye differentiate kar dena: \(\int 2x\,dx = x^{2} + c\) hai, \(2\) nahin. Pehle khud se poochiye: mujhe derivative chahiye ya asal function?
4. Check karte waqt derivative ke baad bhi \(+\,c\) likh dena: \(F(x) + c\) ka derivative sirf \(F'(x)\) hai; constant ghaib ho jata hai.
